payloadFields.name: gameCode
payloadFields.notes: Exactly BATMAN, six ASCII characters. Offset 0.

payloadFields.name: initials
payloadFields.notes: Exactly three uppercase ASCII letters. Offset 7.

payloadFields.name: sourcePoints
payloadFields.notes: Offset 17; 7 digits; 0..999999. Credited arcade points across the run, excluding all stage-clear time bonuses.

payloadFields.name: totalTicks
payloadFields.notes: Offset 24; 7 digits; 1..9999999. Active display refresh ticks; must equal the sum of all five stage tick fields.

payloadFields.name: completedMask
payloadFields.notes: Offset 31; exactly two digits. Allowed 00,01,03,07,15,31 for consecutively completed stages 0..5.

payloadFields.name: stage1Ticks
payloadFields.notes: Offset 33; 7 digits; 0..9999999. Positive if this stage is completed. The next uncleared stage may contain a partial elapsed time (including zero); all later stages must be zero.

payloadFields.name: stage2Ticks
payloadFields.notes: Offset 40; 7 digits; 0..9999999. Positive if this stage is completed. The next uncleared stage may contain a partial elapsed time (including zero); all later stages must be zero.

payloadFields.name: stage3Ticks
payloadFields.notes: Offset 47; 7 digits; 0..9999999. Positive if this stage is completed. The next uncleared stage may contain a partial elapsed time (including zero); all later stages must be zero.

payloadFields.name: stage4Ticks
payloadFields.notes: Offset 54; 7 digits; 0..9999999. Positive if this stage is completed. The next uncleared stage may contain a partial elapsed time (including zero); all later stages must be zero.

payloadFields.name: stage5Ticks
payloadFields.notes: Offset 61; 7 digits; 0..9999999. Positive if this stage is completed. The next uncleared stage may contain a partial elapsed time (including zero); all later stages must be zero.

payloadFields.name: checksum
payloadFields.notes: Offset 68; four characters 0-9/A-F. CRC16/CCITT-FALSE over payload bytes 0..67 then ASCII BATMAN63, excluding the URL prefix.

scorecardFormula: Use integer arithmetic. budgetsSeconds[1..5]=[480,300,60,180,720]. elapsedSeconds(t)=floor(t*20/1199). bonus(i,t)=100*max(0,budgetsSeconds[i]-elapsedSeconds(t)). expectedScore=min(999999,sourcePoints+sum(bonus(i,stageTicks[i]) for completed stages i)). Require score=expectedScore and score>0. Require totalTicks=sum(stage1Ticks..stage5Ticks) and 1<=totalTicks<=9999999. completedMask must be one of [0,1,3,7,15,31]. With n completed stages, stageTicks[1..n] must be positive; if n<5, stageTicks[n+1] may be zero or a positive partial time; all later fields must be zero. For mask 0 there is no completion bonus and score=sourcePoints. Rank overall score descending; equal scores tie. Display time as totalTicks*20/1199 seconds; retain raw integer ticks for validation.
otherNotes:
QR FORMAT: Game code BATMAN. Prefix NGPC-DEV.COM/BATMAN/ is 20 ASCII characters. Overall version 2 has a 72-character body (92 including prefix). Per-stage version 3 has a 36-character body (56 including prefix). Payload lengths exclude the prefix.

OVERALL CHECKSUM: CRC16/CCITT-FALSE, polynomial 0x1021, initial 0xFFFF, no reflection, xorout 0x0000. Feed ASCII body offsets 0..67 followed by ASCII salt BATMAN63; append four uppercase hexadecimal characters at offsets 68..71. Exclude the URL prefix. Validate length, characters, bounds, progress mask, split sum, checksum and score formula.

SCORING AND TIME: sourcePoints contains credited arcade points, excluding clear bonuses. Repeated checkpoint attempts do not duplicate credited rewards. Overall points cover the run; per-stage points cover the cleared stage only. Ranking time uses active display refresh ticks, including deaths and retries. Pauses, menus, loading and cinematics are excluded. Convert ticks to seconds as ticks*20/1199. The gameplay countdown is separate from ranking time.

ELIGIBILITY: Overall records may come from eligible partial runs, game over, saves or full completion. Completing every level is not required. Per-stage records require that stage to be cleared. Runs must start with 1..3 lives. Unlocking cheats disables eligibility even if individual cheat options are off. Normally earned extra lives are allowed. Zero scores cannot be uploaded.

PER-STAGE LEADERBOARDS: Support BATMAN3 alongside overall BATMAN2 under game code BATMAN. Dispatch by the version character at offset 6. Rank five categories separately: 1 Axis Chemicals; 2 Batmobile; 3 Batcave; 4 Batwing; 5 Cathedral. Do not combine stages or mix stage entries with overall entries. Fields use fixed-width ASCII: initials A-Z, numbers zero-padded decimal, checksum uppercase hexadecimal. Stage layout: offset 0, width 6: gameCode (fixed BATMAN); offset 6, width 1: version (fixed 3); offset 7, width 3: initials (A-Z); offset 10, width 1: stage (1..5); offset 11, width 7: score (zero-padded decimal 1..999999); offset 18, width 7: sourcePoints (zero-padded decimal 0..999999; earned during THIS cleared stage only); offset 25, width 7: stageTicks (zero-padded decimal 1..9999999; active-display refresh ticks during this stage); offset 32, width 4: checksum (uppercase CRC16/CCITT-FALSE hex).

PER-STAGE SCORING: For stage i in 1..5: score=min(999999,sourcePoints+100*max(0,budgetsSeconds[i]-floor(stageTicks*20/1199))), budgetsSeconds=[480,300,60,180,720]. Require sourcePoints in 0..999999, stageTicks in 1..9999999 and score in 1..999999. Rank score descending separately for each stage. Equal scores may tie; quicker stageTicks determines the saved record when scores are equal.

PER-STAGE CHECKSUM: CRC16/CCITT-FALSE: poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, no input/output reflection, xorout 0x0000. Feed the 32 ASCII body bytes at offsets 0..31 followed by ASCII salt BATMAN65; append four uppercase hexadecimal digits at offsets 32..35. Exclude NGPC-DEV.COM/BATMAN/.

PER-STAGE EXAMPLE PAYLOADS:
NGPC-DEV.COM/BATMAN/BATMAN3ABC10037500000450000090008368
NGPC-DEV.COM/BATMAN/BATMAN3ABC20023400000340000060008090
NGPC-DEV.COM/BATMAN/BATMAN3ABC30002700000000000020004E8D
NGPC-DEV.COM/BATMAN/BATMAN3ABC40015500000250000030003566
NGPC-DEV.COM/BATMAN/BATMAN3ABC50058000000600000120002A31
